prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a side impact at intersection. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1463; do not mention it.)
text:
This office has been retained to represent the above-named individual in connection with injuries sustained in a side-impact collision at an intersection. Our client was seriously hurt in the incident, and we are presently evaluating the full extent of the injuries and resulting losses.

Please direct all further communications regarding this claim to this office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person. If your insured or any representative of your company has already made contact, please refer any such inquiries to us.

We request that you provide the bodily injury and property damage liability limits of all policies that may apply to the driver and vehicle involved, along with the declarations pages for each policy.

We also ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes photographs, dash camera or telematics data, recorded statements, claim file notes, adjuster reports, vehicle inspection records, and any electronic data from the vehicles involved. Please confirm in writing that these materials are being retained.
